definition: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome (STISS; OMIM #617516) is a congenital neurodevelopmental disorder caused by haploinsufficiency of PSMD12, which encodes a regulatory component of the 26S proteasome. It is characterized by variable expressivity of developmental delay, intellectual disability, speech impairment, craniofacial dysmorphism, and congenital malformations involving cardiac, renal, and preaxial limb structures, accompanied by proteasome dysfunction and activation of type I interferon pathways.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: Haploinsufficiency of PSMD12 has been reported in individuals with neurodevelopmental phenotypes, including developmental delay/intellectual disability (DD/ID), facial dysmorphism, and congenital malformations, defined as Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome (STISS).
